purpose: Executable ledger for the `causal-intervention-counterfactual` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Counterfactual rows require named intervention/model/contrast worlds and invariance requirements. Counterfactual robustness can preserve local support or expose defeat; it cannot by itself establish candidate-native closure.

counterfactual_rows.counterfactual_query: would the same declared bulk/code-subspace target be recovered if the boundary state, decoder, or dictionary chart were varied within the allowed quotient?
counterfactual_rows.alternative_worlds_or_model_intervention: named contrast alternatives, domain shifts, perturbations, ablations, null controls, and negative controls from the route ledgers; never an unrestricted possible-worlds appeal
counterfactual_rows.invariance_requirement: support may be called counterfactually robust only if the declared relation survives the intervention/perturbation family while preserving the route denominator and measurement/systematic constraints
counterfactual_rows.failure_modes: confounding/common-cause explanation, unmanipulable observational fit, simulator target leakage, proxy mechanism substitution, gauge/frame relabeling, prior/model-class dependence, or extrapolation outside validity domain

counterfactual_rows.authority_spend_rule: For multi-route rows, this row-level S-field is a family-level envelope only; route-spendable credit is limited by route_authority_ceilings and the route state ledger.
